terbaru.judul: Emergent Models: Intelligence from Tiny Substrates
terbaru.pelajaran: Empirically, we study a zoo of minimal EM instantiations across discrete and continuous substrates, showing that local-recursive computation at a tiny scale (tens to hundreds of parameters) can extrapolate exactly on simple arithmetic functions, can support control behaviour and online adaptation, while still exposing several limitations.
